entities.summary: Stig Gunnar Andersson-Tvilling was a Swedish ice hockey player. He competed at the 1952 and 1956 Winter Olympics, winning a bronze medal in 1952 and finishing fourth in 1956 alongside his twin brother Hans. Besides hockey he also played one international match for the Swedish association football team.
